topic: Hyrox Expands UK Gym Presence With Nuffield Deal

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Hyrox Expands UK Gym Presence With Nuffield Deal

facts.label: Outlet
facts.value: Athletech News

facts.label: Article
facts.value: The British health club operator plans to introduce Hyrox training at 70 locations by 2028, offering classes at no additional cost to members Hyrox is expanding its presence in the U.K. fitness market through a partnership with Nuffield Health, which has begun rolling out official training programs for the fast-growing fitness racing competition across its health clubs. The nonprofit healthcare and fitness operator plans to offer Hyrox training at 70 clubs nationwide by 2028, with more than 35 locations expected to feature the programming by January 2027. Classes, specialist coaching and in-club Hyrox events are included in standard memberships. Nuffield Health has invested in dedicated training spaces, specialized equipment and instructor training at participating clubs, citing growing interest among its members in competitive fitness. The operator’s 12-week Hyrox training program features three core class formats: Foundation, which introduces members to functional fitness movements; Engine, which focuses on cardiovascular endurance and speed; and Power, which emphasizes strength development. Each training cycle culminates in an in-club Hyrox race simulation, giving members an opportunity to benchmark their progress and prepare for competition. The programming is designed to accommodate experienced Hyrox competitors as well as members who have no intention of racing.

topic: milon Velocity Based Training® – Wenn Training nicht mehr geschätzt, sondern gemessen wird

facts.label: Story
facts.value: milon Velocity Based Training® – Wenn Training nicht mehr geschätzt, sondern gemessen wird

facts.label: Outlet
facts.value: body LIFE

facts.label: Article
facts.value: DAS ENDE DES ZUFALLS – milon Velocity Based Training® DAS ERSTE TRAININGSSYSTEM, DAS ERKENNT, WANN TRAINING WIRKLICH WIRKT Die größte Schwäche des klassischen Krafttrainings ist seit Jahrzehnten dieselbe: Niemand weiß mit Sicherheit, ob der optimale Trainingsreiz tatsächlich erreicht wurde. Trainierende bewegen Gewichte, absolvieren Wiederholungen und Sätze, Trainer geben Empfehlungen und Trainingspläne. Doch die entscheidende Frage bleibt meist unbeantwortet: War die Belastung zu gering, optimal oder bereits zu hoch? Genau hier beginnt eine neue Ära des Krafttrainings. milon Velocity Based Training ® misst nicht nur das bewegte Gewicht, sondern analysiert die Geschwindigkeit jeder einzelnen Wiederholung. Dadurch wird erstmals sichtbar, wie leistungsfähig das neuromuskuläre System tatsächlich ist, wie stark die Ermüdung ansteigt und ob der gewünschte Trainingsreiz erreicht wurde. Das System erkennt automatisch Leistungsabfälle, passt Belastungen an und steuert das Training auf Basis objektiver Daten statt auf Vermutungen. Was Herzfrequenzmessung für das Ausdauertraining und Blutzuckermessung für Diabetiker bedeutet, ist milon Velocity Based Training ® für das Krafttraining: Ein objektives Biofeedback-System, das sichtbar macht, wann Training tatsächlich wirksam ist. Damit wird Krafttraining erstmals präzise, reproduzierbar und individuell steuerbar.

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Shohei Ohtani signs landmark deal

facts.label: Outlet
facts.value: Fitt Insider

facts.label: Article
facts.value: The four-time baseball MVP has signed a lifetime partnership with New Balance, including the renaming of the company’s innovation facility the Shohei Ohtani Sports Research Lab. Since joining the brand in 2023, Ohtani has helped develop performance footwear and apparel alongside the brand’s designers and sports scientists. The deal comes as New Balance tops $9.2B in 2025 sales and continues expanding its presence in Japan, with Ohtani playing a growing role in its global strategy. For New Balance, the partnership goes beyond a traditional endorsement. It gives the brand a long-term relationship with one of the world’s most recognizable athletes, while connecting his performance and influence directly to product innovation.
